title_ru: TACHYON — субъективная плотность времени: новизна, события, память и внимание
origin: User-supplied hypothesis: repetition compresses remembered time, diversity enriches/lengthens remembered time.

hypotheses.H1_retrospective: At fixed objective duration, a greater number of independently recalled contextual/event boundaries predicts a longer retrospective remembered duration compared with homogeneous activity, after adjusting for affect/attention.
hypotheses.H2_prospective: During the interval, reported passage-of-time speed or prospective duration need not follow H1, because attention, boredom, arousal and engagement may cause the reverse or mixed pattern.
hypotheses.H3_event_structure: Event boundaries recalled may outperform unstructured count of remembered details as predictor of retrospective duration; empirically compare models.
hypotheses.H4_not_physical: External physical clock readings are unchanged. This model cannot verify changes to relativity, entropy production, spacetime metrics, or retrocausal communication.

operational_definitions.density_proxy: Number of distinct meaningful remembered context transitions (blind-coded event boundaries) per objective minute. Not a physical dimension of time.
operational_definitions.novelty: Prespecified self-rated subjective novelty plus blinded categorical manipulation check, not equated with raw random sensory stimulation.
operational_definitions.prospective_report: During or immediately after timed exposure: rate felt speed of passing, estimate duration where prospectively instructed.
operational_definitions.retrospective_report: Without forewarning in designated sessions, estimate interval duration from memory after delay (e.g., 24h), plus structured recall of contextual changes.
operational_definitions.boredom_attention_affect: Pre-specified covariates and manipulation checks; fatigue, sleep or emotional state tracked without inferring them from labels.

pilot_design.structure: Within-participant randomized repeated sessions; alternate homogeneous vs varied-but-comparable activities.
pilot_design.sessions: Suggested minimum pilot: 8 sessions per person, each 20 objective minutes, four homogeneous and four varied, random order counterbalanced. This is feasibility/power-planning only, not a calibrated sample size for significance.
pilot_design.separation: Prospective and retrospective judgment conditions must be separated/randomized to avoid making unwarned participants watch the clock.
controls: Same objective duration and measurement hardware
similar physical exertion and effort where feasible
record novelty/interest/boredom/affect without post hoc selection
prespecified exclusion for interruptions and missing reports
negative controls for rehearsal, clock checks and demand characteristics
pilot_design.analysis: Participant-level paired comparisons and hierarchical models; confidence intervals; predeclared outcome and multiplicity; no post hoc optimizer on test reports.
failure_conditions: H1 estimate indistinguishable from zero with informative interval
H1 effect reverses after adjustment or reproducibility checks
Prospective and retrospective measures cannot be separated experimentally
Result depends on retrospectively selected novelty categories
No difference in event-boundary recall despite predicted effect

scientific_boundaries.relation_to_R40_Hawking_CTC: Independent cognitive research lane. Cannot upgrade Hawking chronology/QFT gates.
